title: Home Event
description: Data payload for msg_type 'event'. Carries a Home Assistant state-change or domain event, including before/after state and context.

entity_id.description: Entity ID associated with this event. Null for events not tied to a specific entity.

old_state.description: Previous state value before the event. Null if the entity did not previously exist or state is unavailable.

new_state.description: New state value after the event. Null if the entity was removed or became unavailable.

context_id.description: Home Assistant context UUID identifying the action chain that produced this event.

occurred_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the event occurred.
